body: As I glance down at the letter, I notice it's addressed to me, with a handwritten note on the envelope that says "Meet me at the old warehouse at midnight." My heart racing, I quickly scan the room, but I don't see anyone suspicious lurking about. The fear begins to overwhelm me, and I feel an overwhelming urge to get away from the situation as quickly as possible. I swiftly grab a pen and paper and scribble a hasty note of my own, "I'll never contact you again." With a newfound sense of urgency, I slam the letter into an envelope and seal it with a piece of tape, then rush to the door.
